sections.title: Capex and phase checks, plus live mode
sections.what: Checks how budgets become capex for each industry and currency, checks phase names, and when the live flag is set, checks the portfolio API for duplicates, counts and coverage.

summary: Checks the capital expenditure and phase conversion rules used in the portfolio view, and optionally checks the live portfolio API for consistency.
purpose: Confirms that cross-industry totals use one unit and that each project is counted once.
why: Likely reason: budgets are stored in different units for different industries, so they must be converted before they can be added together.
how: Runs fixed checks on capex for several industries and currencies, then checks phase names. With the live flag, it calls the portfolio endpoint and checks for duplicate projects, industry counts, full coverage against the projects endpoint, valid values and a summary printout.
inputs: Sample objects in the file. With the live flag, the server address from the REPLIT_DEV_DOMAIN environment variable.
outputs: A pass message. With the live flag, a JSON summary of counts.
risks: Live mode builds its address from an environment variable, so a missing value gives a broken address. Euro budgets return no capex, so those projects drop out of totals.
debug: If capex checks fail, read portfolioCapex and the unit rules for each industry. If live checks fail, confirm the server is running and the environment variable is set.
